description.en: Browser automation connector: drives local Edge or Chrome over the DevTools protocol to open pages, read page text, click, fill forms and take screenshots, exposing 11 tools with no runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 浏览器自动化连接器：通过 DevTools 协议驱动本机 Edge/Chrome，可打开页面、读取正文、点击、填表与截图，提供 11 个工具，无运行时依赖。
